outline: This course will teach the use of English in the field of economics and discuss such ideas as world economies, free trade and capitalism through the reading of relevant contemporary literature. In addition, the United Nation's Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) will be introduced. All areas of English proficiency (listening, speaking, writing, reading) in the context of economics and business will be considered.
